title: skills eval: analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5 forbids the literal 'defineDataset', so a correct answer that says a chart 'doesn't need a defineDataset' fails — narrow must_not_contain to the wrong pattern
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-C, mailbox #32588, 6967627637), seen on PR #35077 (#34770).

## What happens
The eval case `analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5` lists the literal `defineDataset` in `must_not_contain`, and `grade.ts` does a case-sensitive substring match. So a correct answer, one saying an ad-hoc chart "doesn't need a `defineDataset`", fails, even though it agrees with `expected_output`.

This is also #34770's own evidence case, so a false fail here skews that card's before/after measurement.

## Done when
- `must_not_contain` is narrowed to the wrong pattern, for example a `defineDataset(` call in the answer's code, not a mention.
- Case #5 is re-run, and the scorecard notes the case change.

Grade: **p2 · domain:skills**. Theme: MCP; the skills eval measures how well external agents are taught. It is an eval false-fail with no customer effect, but it skews a running measurement, so not p3. Routed to seat 4; seat 3 is winding down.
